notes: Exalted: The Fair Folk supplied and intake in progress. 261 rows reviewed and inventoried under docs/references/exalted1e/fair-folk/inventory/: the character-creation overview (split into separate common- and noble-raksha rows), the four base castes (Diplomat/Entertainer/Warrior/Worker), the twelve named noble hybrid castes, the five Graces (Cup/Ring/Staff/Sword/Heart) with their forging rules, the Bedlam mechanic (the raksha's Limit-Trait analog) including all four Virtue-specific Curses, the five new Backgrounds (Birth/Freehold/Gossamer/Retinue/Style), the altered Backgrounds (Artifact/Familiar/Manse/Backing-Contacts-Influence) and the excluded ones (Followers/Resources), the core signature mechanics (Wyld-damage immunity, Craft (Glamour), Wyld Stunts/Bonuses, Gossamer-and-Glamour, Mutation, Shaping Actions/Reality Shaping, Shaping Combat basics, Oaths, Cold-Wrought Iron), and now **all of Chapter Five: Raksha Magic, inventoried end to end**: all five per-Grace Charm trees (Heart/Nirguna 14 rows, Staff/Nirvikalpa 12 rows, Cup/Dharma 48 rows, Ring/Nirvishesha 78 rows, Sword/Nishkriya 42 rows), the universal, non-Grace-gated Assumption-type Charm tree ('the Mask,' 21 Charms), the Vexing/Questing rules, and Glamour Sorcery/Wyld Artifacts/Adjurations/Behemoths (each with its framework plus named purchasable tiers) plus the narrowly-scoped sixth shinma Nirupadhika ('the Way,' determined to be real player-facing content, not a standard sixth Grace or GM lore). Nothing promoted to a production catalog yet. Still needed: Chapter One/Two's setting/lore, Chapter Six's Mountain Folk, and Merits/Flaws specific to Fair Folk (not found anywhere in the book so far). Locked pending the remaining inventory, schema/rules/creator/editor implementation, and passing tests across all five planned families.
